.sewanee-card-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: 30px 24px;
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 40px auto;
}

/* Individual Staff Card */
.sewanee-card {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e5e5e5;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 22px 20px;
  text-align: center;

  box-shadow:
    0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06),
    0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);

  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.sewanee-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow:
    0 3px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10),
    0 10px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
}

/* Staff Name */
.staff-name {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

/* Staff Title */
.staff-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

/* Staff Phone */
.staff-phone {
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.staff-phone a {
  color: #000000; /* Black text for phone */
  text-decoration: none;
}

.staff-phone a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Staff Email */
.staff-email a {
  color: #582D82; /* Sewanee purple */
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.staff-email a:hover {
  color: #4b246f; /* darker purple on hover */
  text-decoration: underline;
